adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from `find(...)` to `filter(...)` and then iterated (`for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`). Inside the `credentialId` + recurring block, it still builds `promises` from **all** `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(type.endsWith('_calendar'))` and, for each credential, loops over **all** `updatedBookings`, but only deletes the **first** calendar reference of each updated booking via `updBooking.references.find((ref) => ref.type.includes('_calendar'))`. Because this whole recurring-delete block now runs once per `reference`, the same deletions will be attempted repeatedly when multiple calendar references exist (duplicate deletes / excessive API calls). Additionally, using `find` means other `_calendar` references on each `updatedBooking` will not be deleted.
